newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber easier, buyers scare.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber easier, buyers scare.

text.p: Indonesian rubber prices were generally easier in late trading on Thursday on thin demand as buyers continued to put pressure on prices, dealers said.
They said prices eased by 0.25 cents to 56.00-56.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.50-55.75 cents fob Palembang, Padang and Surabaya, 55.25 cents fob Jambi and 55.00 cents fob Pontianak.
"The market is getting weaker due to a lack of demand," one dealer said. "Buyers are putting pressure on prices and I think we'll be seeing prices going down a little more."
Dealers said there had been enquiries from Japanese overnight but their bids were about 0.25 cents below offers.
One dealer said a South Korean buyer had shown interest in buying about 200 tonnes of January shipment SIR20 at 56.00 cents/lb fob Medan but no deal had been done yet.
Another dealer said December RSS1 was sold at 126 cents/kg fob Medan, where SIR10 was on offer at 57.50 cents/lb.
